data.name: Krithik
data.gender_notes: Krithik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Krithik is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kritha' which means 'God's creation'. In Hindu mythology, Krithik is a name given to the constellation Pleiades, also known as 'Mrigasira'. The seven stars in this constellation are believed to represent the seven celestial nymphs who were the children of the sage Kashyapa and his wife, Aditi. Krithik is a name of immense spiritual significance and is often associated with creation, fertility, and abundance.
data.etymology: Krithik belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's creation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Krithik total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
